scope: Box basic tab and responsive base-route editing UI

browser.environment: In-app browser with viewport overrides; no physical phone test
checks: Opens on left Basic tab, with existing Box draft restored
Box edited from route returns to same position without adding a block
Box update preserves repeat count of 3
High-Low high-hand, alternation, short pass and swap edit independently
Double Box third pass changed without changing the other three
Shower exposes high-hand and one short pass
Base buttons switch between one and four pass controls
Add, duplicate, move forward, move backward and delete operate correctly
Saved five-block route and modified selections restored after reload
Five-block route plays, including generated boundary throws
Fixed footer cancels generation while retaining selected settings
Preview expansion and playback-settings disclosure open and close
No page or active editor horizontal overflow at 320px
Landscape 844px uses side-by-side preview/editor with 202px editing viewport
No duplicate DOM ids or captured browser console errors

motionChanges: None; existing movement generation and saved route schema preserved
